scenario: 社区搜索 (UGC 短文本搜索): 用户在社区平台搜索帖子、问答、评论等 UGC 内容。 核心指标是搜索相关性 (nDCG) 和点击率 (CTR)。 关注：语义匹配、query 理解、短文本召回、排序模型、LLM 在搜索中的应用。

papers.title: SOAR: Source-Aware Reinforcement Learning with Precise Credit Assignment for Search Agents
papers.authors: Shengze Huang, Zihao Tang, Jinluan Yang, Xin Yu, Zhenghao Lin, Xiao Liu, Zengxuan Wen, Yeyun Gong, Haizhen Huang, Weiwei Deng, Feng Sun, Qi Zhang, Fei Wu, Kun Kuang
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.13157v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for search agents often suffers from evidence fabrication, a failure mode where agents bypass external information ($E_{ext}$) and fabricate an incorrect answer. We argue that this fabrication arises from an over-reliance on unreliable internal knowledge ($E_{int}$) as shortcuts due to the inherent opacity of reasoning trajectories. To address this, we propose SOAR (SOurce-Aware Reinforcement learning), a paradigm that transforms monolithic reasoning into source-explicit trajectories. SOAR (i) disentangles $E_{ext}$ and $E_{int}$ into parallel, observable streams via a Source-Aware Workflow, and (ii) incorporates Source-Consistent Reward to guide the policy evolution. By making information-source attribution explicit, SOAR enables precise credit assignment between different knowledge streams. Evaluations show that SOAR outperforms baselines on 3B and 7B backbones by 7.3% and 5.4%, while reducing evidence fabri
papers.summary: 将模型内部知识与外部检索证据分为可观察的两条信息流，并用来源一致性奖励约束搜索 Agent，避免答对却编造依据。3B 模型七项问答平均准确率为 0.414，Search-R1 为 0.372；证据编造率从 16.08% 降至 4.05%，相对下降 74.81%。这些是离线问答结果，尚不能等同社区搜索的线上收益。
papers.key_insight: 社区问答搜索需要同时检查答案正确性与引用是否支持答案，SOAR 给出了可训练的来源归因机制。可先在复杂 UGC 查询上记录检索证据、内部推断及二者冲突，再试验小规模强化学习；保持 nDCG、CTR 与引用忠实度三套评价，避免只奖励最终答案而鼓励模型绕过检索。
papers.score_reason: 基于正文方法、实验与社区 UGC 搜索场景评价。

papers.title: Do Prompt Optimizers Break Requirements They Are Not Scored On? A Preregistered Study
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.13287v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Prompt optimizers rewrite a prompt to raise one target metric, but prompts also state requirements the metric does not score, such as an output format, citations, or abstention. In a preregistered study, we run GEPA, MIPROv2, and TextGrad on HotpotQA, SQuAD 2.0, and IFEval and count per-item violations of unscored requirements with deterministic checks. By the preregistered criterion, all three optimizers produce regressions, substantially on HotpotQA, where net regression in citation validity reaches 10.7 to 41.6 points while exact match rises by 21 to 34 points. A post-hoc decomposition changes this reading. The optimized prompts elicit reasoning before the required JSON object, and under the 200-token output cap used throughout, 13.9% to 47.0% of responses end before any answer appears. Among parseable outputs, net regression is within 3 points of zero. With a 1,024-token cap, extraction failures disappear, content regression stays be
papers.summary: 预注册研究比较 GEPA、MIPROv2 与 TextGrad，发现优化答案准确率时会破坏未计分的输出契约。HotpotQA 精确匹配提升 21–34 个百分点，同时引用违规回归达 10.7–41.6 个百分点；后续分析发现 200-token 输出限制引起 13.9%–47.0% 的截断，放宽至 1,024 token 后内容回归低于 1 个百分点。核心问题是优化目标与完整契约不一致。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索回答的优化不能只看答案匹配，还应把 JSON 格式、引用、拒答条件和长度限制纳入独立校验。应分别统计解析失败与可解析回答的内容错误，尤其检查输出预算是否被推理耗尽；这能避免把截断误判成知识退化，也能及时发现离线得分上涨但页面无法呈现或引用失效的实际回归。
papers.score_reason: 基于正文方法、实验与社区 UGC 搜索场景评价。

papers.title: Test-Time Memory Construction
papers.authors: Zijun Wang, Yifan Ji, Haidong Xin, Zhenghao Liu, Yukun Yan, Zulong Chen, Yu Gu, Ge Yu, Maosong Sun
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.13348v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle to answer questions over long interaction histories, where relevant evidence may be scattered across distant sessions. Existing memory systems typically construct and maintain sophisticated memory representations offline, before user queries are observed, incurring substantial overhead and limiting their ability to adapt memory construction to query-specific information needs. In this paper, we propose T$^2$Mem, a Test-Time Memory construction framework that defers memory construction to inference and progressively builds memory along the reasoning process. Specifically, T$^2$Mem extracts lightweight episode-level metadata offline to capture key events and temporal associations as retrieval cues, while retaining links to the original interactions to facilitate the reconstruction of dependencies across episodes. At test time, the LLM adaptively retrieves and organizes metadata and raw interactions, pr
papers.summary: T²Mem 将复杂记忆构建推迟到查询时，离线仅保留轻量事件元数据和原始交互链接，由 Agent 随推理逐步检索并组织相关记忆。Qwen3.5-27B 在 LoCoMo 上平均得分 71.69，优于 LazyMem 的 69.84；LongMemEval 达到 84.80，超过 LightMem 的 77.40。开源实现为复现提供入口，但调用成本仍需按业务负载评估。
papers.key_insight: 对于社区连续搜索与追问，可先保存会话事件索引，再根据当前问题补齐原始帖子和历史交互，减少预先构建全量记忆的工作。重点验证知识更新、跨会话引用及用户偏好恢复；论文的长期记忆指标不能直接替代搜索相关性，试点应同时测量额外工具调用、响应延迟和查询级 nDCG。
papers.score_reason: 基于正文方法、实验与社区 UGC 搜索场景评价。

papers.title: MADS: Multi-Agent Dialog Simulation for Robust Conversational Agents
papers.authors: Arkajyoti Chakraborty, Adam Zernik, Ishika Kulkarni, Mudit Arora, Hugo Lin, Justin Chiu, Alessandro Di Bari, Neha Gupta, Andreas Stolcke
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.12757v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Task-oriented conversational agents remain fragile under realistic conditions, especially when users exhibit non-cooperative behavior. Existing function-calling benchmarks underrepresent adversarial conversation trajectories, thereby limiting the training resources available for developing robust agents. We present MADS (Multi-Agent Dialog Simulation), a synthetic data generation pipeline that produces structured, diverse dialogue trajectories. We inject adversarial conversation, producing validated conversation trajectories that capture realistic, unhappy paths. Using MADS, we construct MADS-Bench: a benchmark spanning six domains, 55 personas, and 1095 conversations, with approximately 66% of conversations containing failure-prone conversation scenarios. We evaluate the robustness of the trained models using a two-stage training approach that combines supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR
papers.summary: MADS 用多 Agent 合成并校验非合作用户对话，结合 SFT 与可验证奖励训练工具调用策略。正文表 1 给出 189 段对话、1,095 个轮次，摘要对此表述存在不一致；本文按正文统计。Qwen2.5-7B 的 Pre-Act 工具 F1 从基础模型 0.38 提高到 SFT 的 0.70，再到 SFT+RLVR 的 0.77，展示了失败路径训练的作用。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索助手也会遇到问题改口、信息缺失和不合理工具请求，可为这些轨迹构造明确的工具与参数检查，而不是只用顺畅问答训练。需分别统计轮次级工具准确率和整段任务成功率；MADS 的跨领域数据规模较小，适合作为失败路径设计参考，不能据此认定社区搜索 CTR 会提升。
papers.score_reason: 基于正文方法、实验与社区 UGC 搜索场景评价。

papers.title: How to Rewrite Apache Spark UDFs for GPU Acceleration with AI Agents
papers.abstract: Enterprise applications have become increasingly demanding. Agentic AI has compounded the need for vast amounts of enterprise data with frequent, complex...
papers.summary: NVIDIA 展示通过四个 Agent 技能环节完成 Spark UDF 的测试、转换、基准测量与优化，按 SQL、cuDF 或 CUDA 路线消除 CPU 回退。某大型消费科技公司已转换 30 多个生产 UDF；一个 6,000 亿行负载的算子累计时间由 274.55 小时降至 12.78 小时。这里是特定算子加速案例，不能推断整个搜索链路均获得同等收益。
papers.key_insight: 对社区搜索的数据清洗、特征生产和离线评测，可借鉴以可执行语义测试与性能反馈驱动 Agent 的方法。先筛选确实造成 GPU 回退的 UDF，再校验空值、类型边界和输出一致性，最后比较端到端作业成本；本文主要贡献是工具调用与验证闭环，适合数据工程试点，和在线排序模型优化应分别衡量。

papers.title: Temporal Evidence Forests for Long-Horizon Multi-Party Conversational Memory
papers.authors: Junyou Guo, Chongyang Tao, Yan He, Yong Wang, Shuai Ma
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.12874v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Long-term memory has been widely adopted in LLM-based agents to support persistent interaction and personalized assistance. Long-term multi-party interactions, however, accumulate substantially more detailed information, with decisions repeatedly updated and states evolving across participants and interaction stages. Temporal structure is therefore crucial for tracing such memories: relevant information often appears densely within short intervals, while transitions among different states are anchored by a strict temporal order. Existing temporally aware memory frameworks primarily store time as metadata or use temporal signals to guide retrieval over preconstructed memory structures, without using temporal structure to both recover locally concentrated evidence and reconstruct its complete event progression. To address these limitations, we propose T-Mem, a temporal-structure-based memory framework that preserves interactions and organi
papers.summary: T-Mem 针对多人长期对话中的状态更新与交错讨论，利用时间邻域发现遗漏证据，再构建记录状态转移和支持关系的证据森林。GPT-5.5 配置下，GroupMemBench 总体准确率为 63.09%，HippoRAG2 为 54.50%；EverMemBench 为 79.46%，超过最强已完成基线的 71.04%。结果说明时序组织能够补充单纯的语义相似度。
papers.key_insight: 社区帖子和评论里的纠正、补充与最终结论常发生在相邻时间段，检索相似片段容易混淆旧状态与新状态。可借鉴时间邻域扩展和状态转移结构，把当前事实及其修改来源一起交给回答 Agent；上线前需检查编辑时间、跨用户同名实体及被删除内容，避免时序结构把过时观点重新当成现状。

papers.title: Evo$^2$: Evolving the Evolver through Weight-Harness Co-Evolution
papers.authors: Chejian Xu, Shujian Zhang, Wenxuan Zhou, John Lambert, Beck Chen, Bo Li, Andrew Hard, Rajiv Mathews
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.13025v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Self-evolving agents are increasingly used to improve language model systems without human intervention through either weight updates or harness improvements. Existing approaches typically pursue these directions separately: some methods update model weights using self-generated experience, while others rewrite the harness that defines how an agent uses prompts, tools, context, and execution feedback. However, these approaches overlook the relationship between model weights and the agent harness. To connect these processes and ensure effective and smooth agent self-evolving, we propose Evo$^2$, a framework for weight-harness co-evolution. For harness updates, we design a unified dual-role pipeline that a single policy serves as both a Proposer, which writes harness edits, and a Reflector, which diagnoses their effects and guides revision. For weight updates, harness modifications and their execution outcomes guide the training of both th
papers.summary: Evo² 将 Agent 模型权重与运行框架共同优化，同一策略分别提出框架修改和反思执行结果，EvoTIDE 再结合 SFT 与交错 GRPO 学习可用轨迹。Qwen3.8-27B 在 Polyglot 达到 82.1%，最强基线为 62.6%；SWE-bench Verified 为 48.3%，对比 HGM 的 41.0%。论文也报告记忆任务迁移，但编程基准与社区搜索存在场景差异。
papers.key_insight: 搜索 Agent 的质量同时取决于模型及检索、上下文、停止条件等运行设计，可把框架改动与执行反馈成对记录。社区业务更适合先在冻结模型的情况下迭代提示词和工具策略，再考虑权重训练；每次修改都用未参与优化的查询集检查 nDCG、引用正确性和成本，防止框架进化仅适配训练任务。
papers.score_reason: 基于正文方法、实验与社区 UGC 搜索场景评价。

papers.title: Scaling Agentic Data for Long-Horizon Terminal Intelligence
papers.authors: Shun Zou, Ziyu Ma, Yi Zou, Yong Wang, Lin Chen, Zehui Chen, Guanhua Chen, Xiangxiang Chu, Feng Zhao
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.13166v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Terminal agents are moving beyond local operations toward completing real-world professional tasks. Short trajectories can demonstrate commands and tool calls, but they do not fully show how agents accumulate evidence through exploration, use it to inform judgments, continually adjust strategies based on feedback, and turn intermediate results into final deliverables. High-quality long-horizon trajectories capture these agentic behavioral patterns and their connections within a single problem-solving process, providing richer experience for sustained autonomous work. However, environment synthesis may complete or simplify the key work underlying these patterns in advance and thus remove the need for exploration, implementation, and verification that the agent was meant to perform. To address this, we introduce TerminalHorizon, a fully automated data synthesis engine for long-horizon terminal agents. Starting from real-world professional
papers.summary: TerminalHorizon 从真实专业任务出发，先用独立执行发现被环境构建预先解决的关键工作，再扩展任务以保留探索、纠错和验证。论文构建约 1.5K 环境与 3K 轨迹，训练 Qwen3.5-27B 后 Terminal-Bench 2.0 从 41.6 提升至 55.8，AutomationBench 完成率从 5.5 升至 17.2。结果覆盖 12 个基准，社区搜索迁移仍待验证。
papers.key_insight: 构造搜索 Agent 训练环境时，不应提前提供已经整理完的答案或消除检索困难，否则轨迹只教会执行命令。可将社区复杂查询拆为寻找证据、核对冲突、修订判断和输出可追溯答案，逐步增加约束；同时保留独立验证环节，评价完整任务成功率与相关性，避免把长轨迹或更多调用本身视为能力提升。

papers.title: Agent Evaluation Metric for multi-turn conversations
papers.abstract: AEM decomposes turn-level correctness into truthfulness and completeness. A five-turn example separates one root cause from three downstream failures; no production efficacy numbers disclosed.
papers.summary: AWS 的 AEM 将多轮 Agent 正确性拆成真实性和完整性，并逐轮记录工具、参数及回答的错误原因。文中的五轮示例把第 2 轮的一次错误与后续三次级联失败区分开，说明整段失败计数会掩盖根因。文章提供评价机制和实施路径，没有披露生产提升比例；示例中的数值用于解释指标，而非实证收益。
papers.key_insight: 社区多轮搜索可把错误拆为查询理解、工具选择、参数值、证据覆盖与最终回答，再标注从哪个轮次开始传播。这样同一个错误改写导致的多次失败不会被误算成多个独立问题；采用相似度或模型裁判时，需要用人工标注查询校准阈值，并将这些诊断指标与 nDCG、CTR 和最终成功率并行记录。

papers.title: Automated agent evaluation with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and GitHub Actions
papers.abstract: Evaluate tool-using agents in CI with four built-in evaluation dimensions and a sample 0.8 threshold. Includes working deployment, trace collection and cleanup examples; not a controlled benchmark.
papers.summary: AWS 给出将 AgentCore 与 GitHub Actions 连接的工程示例，在拉取请求上部署 Agent、调用 MCP 工具、收集轨迹并执行四项内置评价。示例以 0.8/1.0 为门槛检查任务成功、正确性、工具选择及参数准确率，再清理测试资源。文章提供可运行流程与失败示范，没有对照实验，门槛数值也不是通用业务标准。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索 Agent 的提示词或工具变更应触发固定查询集回归，检查工具参数和引用，并将模型评分与确定性校验结合。可借鉴每次改动都保留轨迹、输出评价 JSON 和清理资源的闭环；实际阈值需要业务标注校准，且机器间调用示例绕过用户角色检查，权限测试须另设用户身份场景。
